runtime_implementation.scope: Rhino 5 (archive 50) import: layers/attributes, exact curves/surfaces/meshes, blocks/instances, 30/30 BRep editable through OCCT, export/reimport; V6+ deferred.
remaining: Manual UI four-view/select smoke and warning summary review pending.
R5-A fallback cannot display NativeBrep without OCCT because public openNURBS has no ON_Brep::CreateMesh implementation.
Extended V5 annotation/hatch/light remain retained-only; V6/V7/V8 deferred and V4 legacy policy not implemented.
Strict editable mode aborts the whole import on the first unconvertible BRep; best-effort UI wiring pending.
Release import/export timings are 5.37 s / 4.83 s on the measured fixture, close to but still above the proposed 5 s target.
R5-A fallback now emits BREP_DISPLAY_UNAVAILABLE instead of claiming editable/visible BRep; feature-off still cannot display BRep without OCCT.
Tracked OM9_Milestones private reference images still need the planned private-archive move before public audit --strict can pass.
